messages:
Lina: Quick brain-dump — proposing a lifecycle blueprint for catalog entries: lanes = prime / compat / experimental. Need alignment on: minimal bench set, default pin TTL, soft-rollout cadence, enterprise pin exceptions, and deprecation comms. Aim to finalize this week for roadmap inclusion.

Harry: Lane defs sound good. What's the "minimal bench set" you want for prime?

Lina: Draft minimum for prime: p95 latency (hosted), core-quality evals (core-family + customer-critical), and cost-per-1k tokens. Example thresholds in the doc: latency_p95_ms <= 220; quality_pass >= 0.9; cost_delta <= +20% vs baseline.

Zoe: For pin TTL I'm leaning toward 90 days default. Sales will ask for longer but we can offer paid longer pin as a contract option. Also recommend reminder cadence at 30/14/7 days.

Mike: Runtime needs: soft-rollout controller + auto-fallback hooks. Suggested rollout: 7% for 7 days, 30% for 5 days, 60% for 3 days, then cut. Triggers: eval-drop, latency-regress, error-rate > 2x. On trigger, immediate rollback.

Lina: Also proposing embed-compat flag on entries — if true, require extra integration tests and block automated pin eviction. Breaking embed shapes should require owner signoff and extended rollout.

ci-bot: Created CI job "catalog-entry-acceptance" and assigned to zoe for instrumenting customer-like canaries.

Zoe: I'll add canary datasets that mimic enterprise payloads (long sequences, embedding shape variations). Acceptance scripts will live in infra/eval.

Harry: Migration runway: default 90 days after deprecation notice, with a migration-helper CLI to export customer prompts + diffs and a migration SOW for enterprise. Also need a high-usage tenant checklist.

Lina: Owners: Lina(product) finalize spec + comms, Mike(eng-runtime) implement rollout/fallback + feature flag, Zoe(eval) add bench + acceptance scripts, Harry(CS/sales) draft SOW + comms.

Mike: I'll land a feature-flagged rollout controller and a diagnostics dump for failed canaries.

Zoe: I'll target bench PR by Wed EOD.

Harry: I'll draft SOW template and deprecation comms by Thu.

Lina: Meeting Thu 11:00 to lock decisions. If no objections I'll merge the spec Friday and put the initiative on Q3 roadmap. Thanks all.
